b03_0055.en: The common ancestor of many Miho species, including the Ordinary, is thought to be a red fox, not a human. Obviously, it was not a natural evolution but it's thought to have been caused by something transcendent. They look like humans but they're not. Miho have a Mist Flower organ in their bodies that determines the strength of their psychic powers based on the amount of sunlight they receive, which is linked to the mechanites in their bodies. Because of this organ, foxes worship the sun and it's energy.

b03_0059.en: The mist flower organ, or the elegant organ, is an organ that exists only in a Miho's body. It activates water-soluble mecanites and spreads them throughout the body. One of the reasons why it is called the elegant organ is because of the tubes that spread throughout the body are shaped like the stem of an elegant flower. \n\n In order to maintain the Elegant Organ, you must periodically supply mecanites through helianto products.

b03_0135.en: 진짜 정말 많이 후원해주셔서 감사합니다! 캥!
